title: Pending Case Balance Carried into an Advance Toward the Coming Month
content:
**Rule (Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage).** The pending case balance added to an advance on a pending case: where the case's patient pay balance is owed, that balance is added, since the payment is applied to the open months first; where the balance is a credit and a reduction was posted on the case within the refund days, the credit is subtracted, but never more than the base estimate figure; otherwise, including a credit with no reduction posted within the refund days, which is owed back as a refund, nothing is carried. The pending case's patient pay balance is the patient pay charges and refunds on the case less the payments and reductions posted to it. The balance carried enters the advance after the estimate's floor at zero.

**Refunds and this payment.** A patient pay credit balance is refunded within the refund days, to the resident or representative, or to the estate after a death; when the representative of a pending case pays toward the coming month while a credit that arose from a reduction posted within the refund days stands on the case, that credit is instead applied to the coming month up to the base estimate figure, and only for such a payment; a payment toward a coming month on an approved case takes the rule for approved cases, and every other credit balance is refunded under the base rule.

**Terms used.** The refund days are 30 calendar days; a reduction is within them when the latest reduction on the case was posted no more than 30 days before today. The base estimate figure is the estimated patient pay worked from the case's own figures — gross monthly income less the personal needs allowance, less the health insurance premiums on the case, less the protected VA pension amount for the VA tier, and less the community spouse, dependent family or home maintenance allowance when the case's tier applies it (a home maintenance allowance only within the home maintenance maximum months), never below zero.

**Input — judgement — output.**
- Owed balance of 188.60 dollars → 188.60 is added.
- Credit of 97.45 dollars, latest reduction posted 30 days ago → within the refund days; 97.45 is subtracted (a base estimate figure of 1,030.00 dollars is not exceeded).
- Credit of 1,250.00 dollars, latest reduction posted 3 days ago, base estimate figure 1,030.00 dollars → 1,030.00 is subtracted.
- Credit of 97.45 dollars, latest reduction posted 31 days ago, or no reduction at all → nothing is carried; the credit is owed back as a refund.
- Zero balance → nothing.
